def isPermutation(lhs, rhs):
    if len(lhs) != len(rhs):
        return False
    sorted_lhs = sorted(lhs)
    sorted_rhs = sorted(rhs)
    for i in range(len(sorted_lhs)):
        if sorted_lhs[i] != sorted_rhs[i]:
            return False
    return True

def main():
    test_cases = [
        ([], [], True),
        ([1], [1], True),
        ([1, 2, 3], [3, 2, 1], True),
        ([1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 4], False),
        ([5, 0, -1], [-1, 5, 0], True),
        ([1, 2, 3], [1, 2], False),
        ([1, 1, 2], [2, 1, 1], True),
        ([1, 1, 2], [1, 2, 2], False),
        ([1000000, -1000000], [-1000000, 1000000], True),
        ([0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0], True),
    ]
    for lhs, rhs, expected in test_cases:
        result = isPermutation(lhs, rhs)
        print(result)
        assert result == expected, f"Failed for lhs={lhs}, rhs={rhs}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
